import asyncio

async def fetch(name: str, should_fail: bool = False):
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    if should_fail:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} 执行失败")
    return f"{name} 执行成功"

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        fetch("任务A"),
        fetch("任务B", should_fail=True),
        fetch("任务C"),
        return_exceptions=True,
    )

    for i, r in enumerate(results):
        if isinstance(r, BaseException):
            print(f"[异常] 任务{i}: {r}")
        else:
            print(f"[成功] 任务{i}: {r}")

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio

async def task_ok(name: str, delay: float) -> str:
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    return f"{name} 完成"

async def task_fail(name: str, delay: float) -> None:
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    raise ValueError(f"{name} 出错了")

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        task_ok("任务A", 0.5),
        task_fail("任务B", 0.3),
        task_ok("任务C", 0.4),
        task_fail("任务D", 0.2),
        return_exceptions=True,
    )

    for i, result in enumerate(results, start=1):
        if isinstance(result, BaseException):
            print(f"任务{i} 失败：{result}")
        else:
            print(f"任务{i} 成功：{result}")

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio

async def task_ok():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    return "成功"

async def task_fail():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    raise ValueError("出错了")

async def task_also_ok():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    return 42

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        task_ok(),
        task_fail(),
        task_also_ok(),
        return_exceptions=True,
    )

    for i, r in enumerate(results):
        if isinstance(r, BaseException):
            print(f"任务 {i} 失败：{type(r).__name__}: {r}")
        else:
            print(f"任务 {i} 成功：{r}")

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio

async def success():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    return "成功"

async def failure():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    raise ValueError("出错了")

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        success(), failure(), success(),
        return_exceptions=True
    )
    for i, r in enumerate(results):
        if isinstance(r, BaseException):
            print(f"任务 {i} 异常：{type(r).__name__}: {r}")
        else:
            print(f"任务 {i} 结果：{r}")

asyncio.run(main())
